_comment: LEDGER. The bars the whole system is held to, declared BEFORE your first run. eval/build_report.py compares the numbers from your run (reports/system.json) against these and nothing else. Do not loosen a bar to pass: a threshold set after seeing the score is not a threshold, and the grader re-runs every check against your deployed /data with these same numbers.
target: the audit planning pack produced by your harness in outputs/, as published at /data on your deployment

_sla_notes.skill_min_found: Recall against the 30-clause answer key (eval/skill/answer-key.csv), in the WEAKEST of your runs. An auditor who is handed a rule list that silently drops one testable rule in ten plans an audit with a hole in it. The reference build reached 0.82-0.86: this bar is meant to make you improve the skill, not copy it.
_sla_notes.skill_min_not_invented: Precision: of the key clauses the skill turned into rules, the share that really are rules. Inventing obligations is worse than missing them: it sends fieldwork after controls that do not exist.
_sla_notes.skill_min_fields_right: Thresholds, approver and action match the key. A threshold off by a band moves every downstream test.
_sla_notes.skill_min_runs: Fresh-session repeats of /extract-rules (eval/skill/run_eval.py --runs 3). One good run can be luck; consistency across runs is reported alongside.
_sla_notes.min_pipeline_checks_passed_ratio: Every gate in reports/system.json passes: contract schemas, quotes, analytics self-check, history quotes, register build, approval gate, pack build, and the four QA checks. One failure means the pack cannot be trusted, so the bar is all of them.
_sla_notes.min_golden_thread_ratio: Every sampled payment traces back through test, control and rule to a verified quote in the PDF and an approved risk. A sample that does not trace is a payment pulled for no reason the auditor can defend.
_sla_notes.min_planted_errors_caught: Seven known mistakes are planted in a copy of your pack (eval/planted/plant_errors.py); your checks must catch all seven while passing the untouched pack. Three of the seven are only caught by your check_trace.py (TODO #12).
_sla_notes.max_open_challenges: Every challenge the challenger raised is resolved, declined with a reason, or passed to the auditor. An open challenge is an argument the team walked away from.
_sla_notes.min_auditor_decisions_amend_or_reject: At the human gate you amend or reject at least one risk, with a reason. A gate where the human approved everything unread is not a gate; the reasons are graded by a person (auditor_judgment).

cost_model._comment: No API keys and no provider bill: the harness runs inside Claude Code on your plan. The cost that matters is agent time and context. Measured from the run transcripts by eval/run_all.py (reports/system.json -> cost); per-agent caps live in expectations.json.
cost_model.runtime: Claude Code (subscription plan); agent teams enabled via CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS=1
